title: Customer Experience Intern
desc:
Help Shape The Customer Experience Behind The Scenes
As a Customer Experience Intern, you will support the Marketing and Customer Experience team in delivering seamless customer processes and maintaining high-quality customer data.
In this role, you will contribute to various operational activities, including customer information management, sales documentation processes, digital customer communication, and data quality initiatives. You will also gain hands-on experience with global systems such as SAP and Genesys Cloud while working closely with Sales, Customer Experience, and Marketing teams.
This internship offers a unique opportunity to understand customer-facing business processes and play an active role in supporting Hilti's customer experience strategy
What You'll Do
Supporting customer master data maintenance and data quality activities
Verifying and updating customer information, including company and contact details
Supporting sales administration processes and documentation management
Consolidating and reviewing sales-related forms and records
Responding to customer inquiries received through digital channels in line with internal guidelines
Supporting customer account ownership transfer processes in SAP
Working with global customer communication platforms, including Genesys Cloud (CCC)
Collaborating with Customer Experience, Sales, and Marketing teams on day-to-day operational activities
Providing operational support for customer-focused projects and initiatives
Contributing to continuous improvement of customer processes and data accuracy
What You’ll Bring
Bachelor's degree student or recent graduate in Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, or related disciplines
Availability to work full-time or at least 3 days per week during the internship period
Good command of English
Strong attention to detail and accuracy
Proactive and solution-oriented mindset
Strong sense of ownership and willingness to learn
Ability to manage multiple tasks in a dynamic environment
What’s In It For You
We really value our people, and we've worked hard to develop a reward package that reflects this, creating your future to be just how you would want it. Some of our benefits include:
A caring and performance-oriented culture.
A recognised Great Place to Work 2025, which celebrates our commitment to a culture that values care, performance, and innovation for our greatest strength, our people.
Comprehensive career development opportunities that ensure your success is our priority.
Why Hilti
Hilti is a global leader in construction innovation, with more than 34,000 team members across 120 countries. Guided by our purpose, Making Construction Better, we’re driven to keep learning, growing, and finding new ways to make a lasting impact. Here, you’ll be empowered to use your strengths, work with a global and inclusive team, and take on meaningful challenges. At Hilti, you’ll have the chance to make your ideas, achievements, and growth real through purpose, passion, and teamwork.
Commitment to Inclusion
At Hilti, inclusion is a key focus in how we work, lead, and grow together. We are committed to embracing diversity of thought and creating an environment that is inclusive of everyone, everywhere. We continuously strive to ensure every voice is valued and every team member feels empowered to contribute. By building on this foundation, we strengthen our teams, our innovation, and our impact, making construction better together.
